intro.text: An honorspren who died in Ishar's experiments on bringing spren into the Physical Realm.

items.text: Dalinar found Vespan's corpse in Ishar's tent, and the Stormfather said he had known him. Ishar's notes recorded that Vespan lived nearly fifteen minutes after the transfer, longer than other spren, which Ishar put down to honorspren having the most humanlike essences.
